changelog:
- Initial release of geo-conversion-optimizer, a skill focused on balancing AI citation readiness with real-world user conversion.
- Introduces a structured workflow for GEO conversion optimization: clarify business goals, map user/AI intents, audit content, design dual-track strategy, redesign structure/messaging/CTAs, plan measurement, and produce actionable deliverables.
- Guides use when business outcomes like sign-ups, leads, or sales are important—not just informational SEO.
- Emphasizes explicit strategies for aligning AI (GEO) priorities with human conversion requirements, highlighting how to resolve conflicts.
- Includes concrete examples, audit criteria, and integration points with related geo-* skills.
